new_nodes.detail: No cleaning ritual or replaceable mica.

new_nodes.detail: One flat sheet replaces knobs and door button.

new_nodes.label: Tap-to-heat panel
new_nodes.detail: Press anywhere once to heat.

ideas.rationale: One flat touch surface replaces knobs and mechanical buttons.

new_nodes.label: Fixed RF diffuser plate
new_nodes.detail: Static ridges distribute waves without rotation.

new_nodes.label: Uniform passive heating
new_nodes.detail: No turntable motor or speed knob.

ideas.rationale: Uniform heating is passive, removing turntable and power-level learning.

new_nodes.detail: Excess steam stops heating automatically.

new_nodes.label: Steam-done stop

new_nodes.detail: Gel continuity replaces mechanical interlock contacts.

new_nodes.label: Gel-sensing safety
new_nodes.detail: No switch alignment learning.

ideas.rationale: Safety sensing becomes continuous and simple instead of switch alignment.

new_nodes.detail: Power enters through a keyed base without plug.

new_nodes.label: No-plug safe power
new_nodes.detail: No cord or standard voltage learning.

ideas.rationale: Power connection is a single snap fit, no plug knowledge.

new_nodes.detail: Rotating ball selects time and power with one motion.

new_nodes.label: Ball-control cooking
new_nodes.detail: One ball replaces knobs and door button.

ideas.rationale: One ball combines time and power actions for intuitive control.

new_nodes.detail: Housing lights pulse to show heating is active.

new_nodes.label: Visible heating status

new_nodes.label: Weighted safety logic
new_nodes.detail: No separate microswitch logic to understand.

ideas.rationale: Door safety is inferred from weight and motion instead of switches.

new_nodes.detail: Projects cavity image on door surface, not light bulb.

new_nodes.label: Projected cooking view

new_nodes.label: Locking simple start
new_nodes.detail: Safe without complex interlock.

ideas.rationale: Safety locking is merged with the single start action.

new_nodes.detail: Plate contains internal rotating parts driven by RF.

new_nodes.label: Auto stirrer assist
new_nodes.detail: No manual stirring or turntable motor.

ideas.rationale: The plate assists uniform heating without user stirring decisions.

new_nodes.label: Color-coded wireless power puck
new_nodes.detail: Puck position and color set RF power.

new_nodes.label: Puck power selection
new_nodes.detail: Power changes by sliding puck, no knob.

ideas.rationale: Sliding a colored puck selects power visibly without a knob.

new_nodes.label: Thermal resonance sensor
new_nodes.detail: Cavity acoustic resonance changes with cook time.

new_nodes.label: Resonance-set cook time
new_nodes.detail: No dial timing, stop point sensed by material.

ideas.rationale: Cook time is sensed by material resonance, not set by the user.

new_nodes.detail: Thermoplastic seal forms choke geometry during assembly.

new_nodes.label: Self-forming leak seal
new_nodes.detail: No separate choke rim to install or learn.

ideas.rationale: Seal geometry is formed automatically, avoiding user alignment learning.

new_nodes.detail: Ends heating cycle with a neutral scent cue.

new_nodes.label: Aroma done signal
new_nodes.detail: No bell timing or screen reading.

ideas.rationale: A gentle scent cue signals finish without interpreting a bell or dial.

new_nodes.label: Door-mirror camera viewer

new_nodes.label: Mirror-cooked view
new_nodes.detail: No light bulb or door holes.

ideas.rationale: Mirror viewing replaces light and holes with an instantly understandable reflected image.

new_nodes.detail: Electronically ramps magnetron voltage.

new_nodes.label: Gradual microwave ramp
new_nodes.detail: Power starts with one simple step.

ideas.rationale: Starting RF becomes one smooth action, hiding complex voltage logic.

ideas.title: Self-Leveling Turntable

new_nodes.label: Self-leveling turntable base
new_nodes.detail: Motorized base aligns and rotates without manual glass.

new_nodes.label: Automatic plate leveling
new_nodes.detail: No centering or turntable orientation.

ideas.rationale: The plate positions itself, removing user centering learning.

ideas.title: Passive Power Limit by Mass

new_nodes.label: Mass-sensing power limiter
new_nodes.detail: Passive load resistor sets max watts from food mass.

new_nodes.label: Auto wattage by weight
new_nodes.detail: No power level selection.

ideas.rationale: Weight determines safe wattage and time automatically.

ideas.title: No-Button Weight Start

new_nodes.label: Weight-activated start tray
new_nodes.detail: Tray starts safe heating when food is added.

new_nodes.label: Set-and-start cooking
new_nodes.detail: No button or dial at all.

ideas.rationale: Simply placing food on the tray starts cooking with no buttons.

ideas.title: All-In One Plate Sensor

new_nodes.label: Integrated plate sensor
new_nodes.detail: Plate measures moisture and weight and drives cycle.

new_nodes.label: One-place auto heating
new_nodes.detail: Only action is putting food on plate.

ideas.rationale: Plate sensing selects settings, so the user has no controls to learn.

ideas.title: One-Action Cooking Capsule

new_nodes.label: Insert cooking capsule
new_nodes.detail: Capsule carries preset energy and opens at end.

new_nodes.label: Capsule auto cooking
new_nodes.detail: User inserts capsule and closes door once.

ideas.rationale: Capsule insertion and door closing are the only actions needed.

new_nodes.detail: One molded door module combines window, latch, handle, and hinge, replacing separate mechanical assemblies.

new_nodes.label: Whole-Door One Action
new_nodes.detail: The whole door becomes the user control, reducing individual button and latch decisions.

ideas.rationale: A unified door teaches one object instead of several controls, lowering the learning surface.

ideas.title: Capacitive Door Strip

new_nodes.label: Capacitive Door Strip
new_nodes.detail: A light-touch strip along the door edge replaces the push-release button and lever.

new_nodes.label: Gentle Door Release
new_nodes.detail: Any soft touch opens the door without pressing a small exact button.

ideas.rationale: A forgiving touch area helps users open the door without hunting for the right button.

ideas.title: Bimetal Door Ejector

new_nodes.label: Bimetal Door Ejector
new_nodes.detail: A bimetal spring opens the door when heating ends, replacing manual door release action.

new_nodes.label: Auto Door Release on Done
new_nodes.detail: Completion physically reveals the cavity without user interpretation.

ideas.rationale: The microwave tells the user it is done by opening the door, removing the need to understand the bell or timer.

ideas.title: Vibrating Door Handle

new_nodes.label: Vibrating Door Handle
new_nodes.detail: A handle that buzzes when cooking finishes replaces reliance on visual cues or precise timing interpretation.

new_nodes.label: Haptic Completion Signal
new_nodes.detail: A gentle vibration signals that the cavity is safe to open.

ideas.rationale: Touch feedback is immediate and intuitive, helping users know when cooking is complete without learning status cues.

ideas.title: Aroma Done Sensor

new_nodes.label: Aroma Done Sensor
new_nodes.detail: A crude chemical odor sensor stops cooking when food reaches a target scent, replacing fixed timing.

new_nodes.label: Smell-Based Cook Stop
new_nodes.detail: Ends cooking when the food seems done by aroma.

ideas.rationale: A radical scent-based stop frees users from choosing minutes and matching food readiness.

ideas.title: Load-Sensing Cooking Pod

new_nodes.label: Load-Sensing Cooking Pod
new_nodes.detail: A simple weight-sensitive pod under the plate sets time and power automatically.

new_nodes.label: Weighted Auto Cooking
new_nodes.detail: Chooses sensible settings from how much food is inside.

ideas.rationale: The user just puts food in and presses start; the weight determines the settings without learning.

ideas.title: Inertial Start Knob

new_nodes.label: Inertial Start Knob
new_nodes.detail: A heavy spinning knob starts when released and its flywheel inertia sets approximate duration.

new_nodes.label: Spin-to-Start Cooking
new_nodes.detail: Spin it harder for a longer natural cook.

ideas.rationale: A playful spin gives a physical feel for time without numeric knobs, reducing learning.

ideas.title: Pull Chain Timer

new_nodes.label: Pull Chain Timer
new_nodes.detail: A pull chain like a lamp cord starts default cycles, replacing the timer knob.

new_nodes.label: Pull-Start Duration
new_nodes.detail: Each pull adds one familiar cooking interval.

ideas.rationale: Pull chains are already known from lights and fans, giving an easy physical interaction for cooking.

ideas.title: Color Mesh Indicator

new_nodes.label: Color Mesh Indicator
new_nodes.detail: An LED-lit colored mesh behind the door shows status colors instead of letting users interpret darkness or light.

new_nodes.label: Colored Door State
new_nodes.detail: Green means heating, red means hot wait, blue means done.

ideas.rationale: Color states replace ambiguous window observation with a simple rule anyone can follow.

ideas.title: Thermochromic Time Sticker

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic Time Sticker
new_nodes.detail: A cheap heat-colored sticker on the door changes color as the default cooking time passes.

new_nodes.label: Printed Countdown
new_nodes.detail: Uses passive color change to show progress without dials.

ideas.rationale: A simple sticker gives time feedback without requiring users to learn a timer mechanism.

ideas.title: Shape Memory Door Button

new_nodes.label: Shape Memory Door Button
new_nodes.detail: A shape-memory alloy button deforms after heating finishes to release the door automatically.

new_nodes.label: Warm-to-Open Door
new_nodes.detail: Heat completes the cycle and physically opens the latch.

ideas.rationale: The door itself becomes the completion indicator, removing the need to interpret timer state.

ideas.title: Universal DC Timer Motor

new_nodes.label: Universal DC Timer Motor
new_nodes.detail: A cheap DC motor with gearbox replaces mains-frequency synchronous timer motor for one global timer design.

new_nodes.label: One-Mains Timer
new_nodes.detail: Works identically across regions without user adjustment.

ideas.rationale: A universal timer avoids confusing users with voltage or frequency-related differences.

ideas.title: Plastic Interlock Cam

new_nodes.label: Plastic Interlock Cam
new_nodes.detail: A molded plastic cam and latch replaces a heavier metal lever door button assembly.

new_nodes.label: Cheap Safe Door Action
new_nodes.detail: Provides a simpler, quieter, lighter door opening mechanism.

ideas.rationale: A cleaner, simpler latch action reduces mechanical confusion and lowers parts count.

ideas.title: Static Wave Diffuser

new_nodes.label: Static Wave Diffuser
new_nodes.detail: A fixed ceramic diffuser replaces rotating turntable glass and motor.

new_nodes.label: Turntable-Free Even Heating
new_nodes.detail: Distributes energy enough to remove the user action of centering plates.

ideas.rationale: Without a turntable, users do not need to learn plate alignment or worry about jams.

ideas.title: Shaking Base

new_nodes.label: Shaking Base
new_nodes.detail: A mild vibration base replaces turntable rotation by gently moving the plate.

new_nodes.label: Auto Plate Shaker
new_nodes.detail: Keeps liquid or small foods roughly mixed without user setup.

ideas.rationale: A visible gentle motion helps users understand that cooking is working without technical setup.

ideas.title: Magnetic Stirrer Dish

new_nodes.label: Magnetic Stirrer Dish
new_nodes.detail: A special dish with a magnetic stir bar moves inside the food during cooking.

new_nodes.label: Food Self-Stirring
new_nodes.detail: Reduces uneven heating without asking the user to interpret power levels.

ideas.rationale: The food helps itself, so the user does not need to learn about rotation, power, or hot spots.

ideas.title: Phone-Mirrored Door

new_nodes.label: Phone-Mirrored Door
new_nodes.detail: The door acts as a phone camera mirror surface so users can inspect the cavity through an external phone image.

new_nodes.label: Phone Interior Mirror
new_nodes.detail: Turns a familiar phone check into the viewing action.

ideas.rationale: Many users already know how to check things with a phone, making interior inspection easier than learning microwave window cues.

ideas.title: No-Light Smart Lid

new_nodes.label: No-Light Smart Lid
new_nodes.detail: An opaque lid with a microphone and speaker replaces viewing holes and lamp with sound cues.

new_nodes.label: Sound-Only Door State
new_nodes.detail: Announces heating, ready, and done using plain words.

ideas.rationale: Plain spoken status removes the need to interpret window, lights, or bell timing.

ideas.title: Acoustic Door Lens

new_nodes.label: Acoustic Door Lens
new_nodes.detail: A sound-transmitting lens lets users hear boiling and sizzling instead of watching through a dark window.

new_nodes.label: Sound-Brightened Viewing
new_nodes.detail: Makes cooking status audible and easy to recognize.

ideas.rationale: Sound is often more intuitive than faint visual details in a microwave window.

ideas.title: E-Ink Control Panel

new_nodes.label: E-Ink Control Panel
new_nodes.detail: A low-cost e-ink panel shows only one large pictogram and one button at a time, replacing two knobs.

new_nodes.label: Pictogram-Only Settings
new_nodes.detail: Displays just the necessary choice in large symbols.

ideas.rationale: Showing one large picture at a time prevents users from being overwhelmed by dials and scales.

ideas.title: Steam Whistle

new_nodes.label: Steam Whistle
new_nodes.detail: A tiny steam whistle in the vent path sounds when boiling occurs, replacing some timer interpretation.

new_nodes.label: Natural Whistle Done
new_nodes.detail: Uses food behavior rather than only electronics to show cooking progress.

ideas.rationale: A familiar kettle-like whistle gives direct, easy-to-understand feedback about cooking.

ideas.title: Scent Release Timer

new_nodes.label: Scent Release Timer
new_nodes.detail: A tiny timed scent capsule opens when cooking finishes, giving an olfactory done signal.

new_nodes.label: Smell Completion
new_nodes.detail: A pleasant smell indicates the microwave cycle is over.

ideas.rationale: Smell is a primitive cue that can tell users when something is complete without learning electronic status.

ideas.title: Pictogram Food Dial

new_nodes.label: Pictogram Food Dial
new_nodes.detail: A dial with large food pictures and color-coded rings replaces numbers and microwave power levels.

new_nodes.label: Picture Cooking Selection
new_nodes.detail: Users match a picture to their food instead of learning cooking settings.

ideas.rationale: Pictures are instantly meaningful to many users, especially when technical microwave settings are unfamiliar.

ideas.title: Open-Close Only Door

new_nodes.label: Open-Close Only Door
new_nodes.detail: Opening pauses the cook and closing resumes a fixed default, removing separate timer and start controls.

new_nodes.label: Open Close Cook
new_nodes.detail: The door state itself controls cooking continuation.

ideas.rationale: Users already understand that an open oven is paused, so this makes cooking control intuitive.

ideas.title: Door Turn Stopwatch

new_nodes.label: Door Turn Stopwatch
new_nodes.detail: Rotating the door handle like a wind-up key sets a rough duration and starts cooking.

new_nodes.label: Door Rotation Timer
new_nodes.detail: Uses wind-up motion to communicate time setting.

ideas.rationale: A physical wind-up motion is easier to understand than reading a dial, helping short-duration cooking.

ideas.title: One-Pod Microwave Core

new_nodes.label: One-Pod Microwave Core

new_nodes.label: Pod Insert Cook
new_nodes.detail: The pod replaces all time and power choices with one physical object.

ideas.rationale: The pod becomes the entire user interface: put it in, close it, and cooking begins.
